_file: ops/metrics/bench-matrix.json — configurations and thresholds of the first LLM measurement (F-8 / T-013).
_source: Docs/dev-team/architecture/adr/ADR-005-llm-gateway-providers-models.md addendum 2 p. 5, addendum 3 (the user's decision of 2026-09-12) and the execution note of 2026-09-12 (T-435)
Docs/dev-team/requirements/nfr.md v0.5 NFR-002, NFR-022, NFR-076, NFR-090
_contract: The architect edits this file; scripts/llm-bench.{sh,ps1} read it and never change. A key added here is inert until a script reads it, so it is safe to record intent in advance.
_n_per_cell: Deviation from infrastructure.md §6.4 (20), decided in T-013: testdata/bench/prompts.jsonl holds 10 situations per phase, and repeating a prompt inside one run would be answered from the prompt cache of llama.cpp (usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens) — a repeated request measures the cache, not the model, and would pull p95 down. The sample size the decision rests on comes from runs_required instead: 3 runs x 10 = 30 measurements per cell.
_runs_required: Three runs at different moments (different days, or after a restart of llama-server), each a separate invocation of the script; verdict=pass in all three is what accepts a configuration (§6.4 rule 2).
_cells: A configuration is measured in the cells of num_ctx x kv_cache. The server is started with those parameters before the run (make llm-up with MV_LLM_NUM_CTX; --ctx-size = MV_LLM_NUM_CTX x slots) — the script does not restart the server, it only records the values it was told (§6.4 rule 1). The counted runs of E in T-402 went outside these cells twice over: a 4 x 200192 window and a q4_0 KV, which is not one of the two types above (T-435, two named deviations).
_model_ids: Model ids here, in the blueprints and in ops/models.txt are file stems. The server has to report the stem itself (llama-server --alias, task T-437); without --alias it reports the path to the file, the bench skips the phases and the platform cannot match the model of a blueprint (T-435, ADR-005 execution note p. 6). No alias field is added here.

E._note: One dense 27B for both the tick and the narrative. 13.1 GB of weights + KV 256 KiB/token f16 (64 layers x 4 KV heads x head_dim 256) ~ 2 GB @8k, ~ 4 GB @16k. Base configuration for the transition since T-435 (decision.chosen): it holds NFR-002 but fits only ~163 generated tokens into the 5 s budget, which is why the target of the narrative is Q36-A3B (ADR-005 addendum 3). The stand fitted a 4 x 200192 window in 19.4 GB of the whole GPU, which the KV arithmetic above cannot explain at any KV type (q4_0 gives ~55 GiB, f16 ~195 GiB; baseline.md §4 p. 3 calls the model hybrid): the upper bound of expected_vram_mb still holds for the cells, the per-token figure is not trusted.

E+._note: Material only (ADR-005 add. 2 p. 5): measured when E passes the narrative but the tick costs too much. Needs llama-server in router mode — make llm-up ROUTER=1 (--models-dir, no -m).

Q36-A3B._note: Target configuration of the narrative since 2026-09-12 (the user's decision, ADR-005 addendum 3): the owner wants a narrative longer than E affords. It becomes the base once it takes three pass runs by the method AND its tail of 'other' time above 2 s is gone or explained by prompt_ms — session T-438, after T-434 and T-437. MoE, 35.5 B total / ~3 B active, file Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q3_K_XL.gguf of 17 216 578 048 bytes (16.0 GiB = 16 419 MiB). Lower bound of VRAM = weights + ~1 GiB of KV and compute buffers at 8k; upper bound = the whole GPU with the desktop measured at a 4 x 200192 window (19 595-19 641 MB), which a 1 x 8192 cell does not exceed. Budget of a phase2 answer from its own requests: ~220 tokens with the current tail, ~410 without it (107.2 tokens/s at worst, 'other' 2801 ms with the tail and 1027 ms without).

C._note: Second fallback since T-435 (was the first). May equally be run as GGUF on llama-server — then set provider to openai_compat and url_env to MV_LLM_URL; the metrics are the same, only the base URL differs. With Ollama the script uses its OpenAI-compatible endpoint (MV_OLLAMA_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 in .env; see ops/metrics/README.md).

A._note: Third fallback since T-435 (was the second): two models resident at once (OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=2, or llama-server in router mode). The tick model and the narrative model differ — the script picks the one that belongs to the phase.

_decision_order: E first (overview §18.1, ADR-005 add. 2 p. 5); Q36-A3B was put before C by T-435 and the order E -> Q36-A3B -> C -> A is confirmed by the owner on 2026-09-12 (ADR-005 addendum 3; OQ-A-18 closed). The rule of selection changed with it: a configuration is taken when it passes the thresholds AND gives the narrative length the product wants, not merely when it is the first pass in this order. The order is a rule for the operator, not for the script: the script measures exactly the configurations it is given in --configs.

request._enable_thinking: Mandatory, not a preference: with thinking on, llama.cpp does not apply the json_schema grammar (ggml-org/llama.cpp#20345, open since 2026-03) and the answer may arrive wrapped in markdown or with foreign fields. Turning it off is what makes valid_json_ratio a measurement of the model rather than of the defect.
request._sampling: The Unsloth non-thinking profile for Qwen3 (ADR-005 add. 2). The server is started with the thinking profile (--temp 1 ...); the gateway overrides it per request, so the bench overrides it too — otherwise the measurement would not describe the path the platform actually takes.

NFR-002._note: p95 from combat.decided to delivery, one active scope. The bench measures only the LLM call, which is the dominant term; the bus and the gateway add tens of milliseconds and are measured separately in B1.

NFR-002-group3._note: The group threshold is fixed after the measurement (nfr.md NFR-002, metrics.md §7 B1; the reference point from the product analyst is no worse than twice the solo figure). Until then the verdict of this phase is advisory and never blocks a configuration.

NFR-090._note: Russian narrative: not a single CJK character, Latin letters at most 10 % of all letters (entity identifiers inside the JSON are counted too — that is deliberate, the gateway measures the text the player sees, and the bench keeps the same rule for comparability).

B3._note: metrics.md §7 B3 / NFR-022. With grammar sampling on a working build this ratio is expected to be 1.0; anything lower is a signal about the build or the schema, not about the model.

NFR-076._note: Everything resident in the 24 GB of the RTX 4090. The number is an expectation, not a wall: exceeding it means part of the layers or of the KV cache went to RAM, which the operator marks by hand in baseline.md (§6.4 rule 4). nvidia-smi reports the whole GPU, so a browser or a compositor inflates it — read it together with the model size.

throughput._note: Derived, not required by an NFR: the phase2 prompts of the bench cap an answer at 320 tokens (the group prompts at 512), so fitting a 5 s budget with room for prompt processing needs roughly 70 generated tokens per second. Useful as an early signal. E passed NFR-002 at 40-48 tokens/s because its answers are short (85-88 tokens on average, 130 at most); the consequence is a cap on the narrative length, not a waiver — max_tokens 160 for a solo phase2 answer on E, and ~220 (current tail) to ~410 (tail gone) on the target Q36-A3B, final figures after T-438 (T-439, ADR-005 execution note p. 4).

results._shape: Filled in after a run on the stand, from the JSON reports the script writes (ops/metrics/bench-<config>-<date>.json). One entry per configuration: an array of runs, each {run, counted, date, path, num_ctx, slots, kv_cache, kv_cache_source, llamacpp_build, verdict, phase2_p95_ms, group3_p95_ms, tps{tick, phase2, phase2-group3}, vram_used_mb, report, note}. kv_cache_source is needed because the script records what it was told: the CSV of T-402 carries kv_cache=unknown, and the q4_0 below comes from the owner. llamacpp_build is the build_info of GET /props (the CSV of T-402 carries the pin b10441(pin), see baseline.md §1). vram_used_mb is the whole GPU with the desktop. The decision itself lives in ops/metrics/baseline.md — this field is the machine-readable trail behind it.

decision.chosen_role: base for the transition: it holds NFR-002 today, but fits only ~163 generated tokens into the 5 s budget
decision.target_condition: three pass runs by the method in the platform cell AND the tail of 'other' time above 2 s gone or explained by prompt_ms (session T-438, after T-434 and T-437). Then it becomes the base and the blueprints plus schemas/agent/narrative.json move to it in one data edit (T-260).
decision.selection_rule: a configuration is taken when it passes the thresholds AND gives the narrative length the product wants (the user's decision of 2026-09-12, ADR-005 addendum 3) — not merely the first pass along decision_order.
decision.decided_by: architect#1 (T-435); the selection rule and the target — the user, 2026-09-12
decision.adr: ADR-005, addendum 3 and the execution note of 2026-09-12 (T-435)

runs: 1 x E in the platform cell (8192 x 1, f16, --alias), another day — proves the cell
3 x Q36-A3B in the same cell, a restart before each — accepts or rejects the target
calibration of characters per token via POST /tokenize for both models — feeds text.maxLength of T-439
planned_session._note: The owner restarts the server; the operator runs the bench. Full table of runs and outcomes — the T-438 section of the EPIC-001 index.

decision._passed_definition: 'E passed' in the control run means all three at once: verdict=pass by NFR-002 (p95 <= 5000 ms), p95 <= 4400 ms and median <= 3000 ms. At n=10 the p95 of a run is its slowest request, so the 4400 ms line alone would fire on a single outlier while the run still passes the NFR; the median (2470 ms in the counted runs) is what keeps the decision off one request.
decision.revisit_if: E did not pass in the control run by the definition above: U-2 reopens — first the 'other' time by prompt_ms (T-434), then decision_order. A run that passes NFR-002 but breaks the 4400/3000 ms lines is a signal to revisit, not a refusal: it says the platform cell (f16, 8192) is slower than the counted runs on q4_0. If the target Q36-A3B does not take three pass runs or its tail stays unexplained, the question 'a longer narrative or the 5 s of NFR-002' goes back to the owner; until the answer the base stays E with a cap of 160 tokens.
decision._note: The counted runs were made in a 4 x 200192 window and on a q4_0 KV: two deviations from §6.4 rule 3, accepted for the verdict and not for the configuration of the platform, whose cell is the one above (ADR-005 execution note p. 2). Blueprints of MVP-1 state E until the target is accepted.
